<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Utility for Alert Management calibration and setup.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil = Class.create();
WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil.prototype = {

    initialize: function() {},

    runFixScript: function() {

        var LOG = '[Alert Management Calibration] ';
        var errors = [];
        var logs = [];
        var appid = '';

        /* =====================================================
         * Helper functions 
         * ===================================================== */

        // SUCCESS logs. Routine detail goes to gs.debug: written only when
        // x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.logging.verbosity is 'debug'.
        function logInfo(name, value) {
            logs.push({
                name: name,
                status: true,
                message: value || ''
            });
            gs.debug(LOG + name + ' - ' + value);
        }

        // ERROR logs
        function logError(name, value) {
            errors.push(name);
            logs.push({
                name: name,
                status: false,
                message: value || 'Failed'
            });
            gs.error(LOG + name + ' - ' + value);
        }
        // WARN logs (a configuration state, not a failure)
        function logWarn(name, value) {
            errors.push(name);
            logs.push({
                name: name,
                status: false,
                message: value || 'Failed'
            });
            gs.warn(LOG + name + ' - ' + value);
        }

        function getScopeSysID(name) {
            var sysId = gs.getCurrentApplicationId();

            if (sysId) {
                appid = sysId;

                gs.debug(LOG + 'Scope - ' + name);
            } else {
                gs.debug(LOG + 'Scope - Not found: ' + name);
            }
        }

        /* =====================================================
         * API STATUS CHECK
         *
         * Checks that the connection settings are present. The live connection test is off
         * in this version: the only Fastn call available for it (getTenantsChildren) needs a
         * tenant ID, which setup no longer asks for. A tenant-free check returns in v2.
         * ===================================================== */

        function validateAPIConnection() {

            var apiKey = gs.getProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.api.fastn.api.key');
            var baseUrl = gs.getProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn_api_baseurl');
            var spaceId = gs.getProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn.space.id');

            // NOT CONFIGURED
            if (!apiKey) {
                logWarn('API Status', 'Not Configured');
                return;
            }

            // Missing dependencies 
            if (!baseUrl || !spaceId) {
                logWarn('API Status', 'Configured but Missing Required Properties');
                return;
            }

            logInfo('API Status', 'Configured');
        }

        /* =====================================================
         * START
         * ===================================================== */

        gs.debug(LOG + 'Started');

        try {

            /* =====================================================
             * URL Calibration
             * ===================================================== */

            getScopeSysID('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam');

            logInfo('URL Calibration', 'Done');

            /* =====================================================
             * API Status
             * ===================================================== */
            validateAPIConnection();



        } catch (e) {
            logError('Unhandled failure', e.message);
        }

        var finalStatus = errors.length === 0;

        return {
            success: finalStatus,
            message: finalStatus ? 'Setup completed' : 'Setup failed',
            logs: logs
        };
    },

    resetSetup: function() {
        var LOG = '[Alert Management Calibration - RESET] ';


        try {


            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.api.fastn.api.key', '');
            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn_api_baseurl', '');
            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.tenants', '');
            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn.space.id', '');
            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.tenant.type', '');
            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.notify_failure_group', '');

            gs.debug(LOG + 'Properties cleared');


            var tenantGr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_tenant_list');
            tenantGr.query();
            tenantGr.deleteMultiple();


            return {
                success: true,
                message: 'Setup reset successful'
            };


        } catch (e) {
            gs.error(LOG + e.message);


            return {
                success: false,
                message: e.message
            };
        }
    },

    type: 'WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-26 08:56:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>b307d2bf2bfecb10eb1cfbfdf291bfe5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>33</sys_mod_count><sys_name>WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_b307d2bf2bfecb10eb1cfbfdf291bfe5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-23 13:34:36</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
